title: Guard the Signup Gate

scenario.intro: Glitch is flooding the gate with fake signups! Only real recruits get through.
scenario.goal: Add validation to SignupRequest: `{{field_name}}` must be {{name_min}}–{{name_max}} characters and `{{age_field}}` must be between {{min_age}} and {{max_age}} (inclusive). Bad requests should bounce with 422.

objective: Real recruits get in (201). Anyone with bad papers bounces (422).
rules: Anything that breaks a rule bounces with 422.
starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

app = FastAPI()


class SignupRequest(BaseModel):
    # >>> EDIT START
    {{field_name}}: str
    {{age_field}}: int
    # <<< EDIT END


@app.post("/signup", status_code=201)
async def signup(body: SignupRequest) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"welcome": body.{{field_name}}}
reference_solution:
{{field_name}}: str = Field(min_length={{name_min}}, max_length={{name_max}})
{{age_field}}: int = Field(ge={{min_age}}, le={{max_age}})

hints.text: Right now every field accepts anything. What should happen when {{age_field}} is 5?
Pydantic's Field() takes limits: ge=/le= for numbers, min_length=/max_length= for strings.

dialogue.start: Nobody gets in without the right papers!
dialogue.success: Clean gate! Glitch's fakes bounced right off.
dialogue.fail: Uh-oh, some fakes slipped through. Check which packets got in.
